text:
Ian R: POC with BetaCorp — they ran a stress test and reporting shows free credits not decrementing, but billing spikes. They saw a bunch of 429s and retries. Can we swarm? cc @Alex K
Alex K: On it. Which sandbox/region and any request ids we can use to correlate?
Ian R: sandbox-us-west, project beta-456. Example client log lines pasted by their engs:
```
2026-02-03T18:23:11Z INFO req_id=cb12 tokens=0 resp=200
2026-02-03T18:23:12Z WARN req_id=cb13 resp=429 retrying
2026-02-03T18:23:12Z INFO req_id=cb13 retry req_id=cb14 resp=200 tokens=950
```
Console for beta-456 shows remaining free_credits unchanged after the run (still 10000). Billing view shows spike on invoice preview.
Jordan P: I saw a similar pattern: client retries without idempotency key -> duplicates in telemetry; sometimes tokens are counted on retry but console caches can still show stale remaining_credits until reprocessing.
Maria G: Are they using streaming or regular generation? Streaming aborts can produce weird token accounting if the client closes the socket.
Ian R: They used streaming in parts of the test. Also attached their agent config (they didn't include idempotency-key header).
Dev-Bot: deploy: telemetry-dedupe patch deployed to sandbox (canary) — deploy id=deploy-983 at 18:30 UTC
Alex K: I pulled meter events for beta-456: meter_event_count spikes correspond to many events with status=aborted or status=success but token_sum=0 for a lot of them. Suspect ingestion race + caching. Enabling debug-level meter logs now.
Liu: Looking at proxy logs, I see multiple entries with the same client-side request sequence but no idempotency-key. X-Retry-Count: 1 on a bunch of requests, backend got 2-3 identical calls. Our ingestion currently treats each as separate usage events.
Billing-Bot: note: free_credits on console are read from a fast cache (TTL 60s) and invoice preview recalculates from processed meter events. A backlog or reprocessing can make console appear stale.
Ian R: Customer is worried about unexpected charges — they want a short explanation and a temporary cap while we fix.
Jordan P: Immediate plan: 1) Apply a soft throttle/cap for beta-456 (1k tokens/min) 2) Enable debug meter logs and keep telemetry snapshot 3) Purge duplicate ingestion entries and reprocess 4) Ask customer to add idempotency-key header on retries. Who can apply the cap?
Alex K: I can set the cap now and keep it until we reconcile. I'll also patch telemetry dedupe rule to prefer idempotency-key and expire identical events within 5s. If no idempotency-key, we will mark duplicates and send to manual queue instead of double counting.
Maria G: I'll draft a 3-bullet runbook to send BetaCorp: what happened, immediate mitigation (cap + reprocess), action items for them (send idempotency-key, avoid aggressive client retries), and ETA.
Liu: I located req_id cb13 in the ingestion queue — there were 3 entries. I'll purge the duplicates and trigger reprocess to recalc token sums. Logging shows token_sum 950 on the final success line so reprocessing should decrement free_credits.
Billing-Bot: Created ticket BILL-4821 to track reconciliation and customer communication: https://redwood.internal/tickets/BILL-4821
Ian R: Thanks — can you provide a single-paragraph summary and an ETA for when the console and invoice preview will match?
Alex K: Summary for customer: "We observed client retries without idempotency keys during your load test, which created duplicate usage events and temporarily desynced the console cache from processed billing events. We've applied a temporary quota cap, enabled debug logging, and purged duplicate ingestion events; reconciliation is in progress." ETA: reconciliation and final invoice preview update in ~4 hours. I'll update this thread when done.
Jordan P: After reconciliation we'll run a small controlled test with idempotency headers to validate fixes.
Maria G: I'll send the runbook text in a DM and cc you, Ian, for customer-facing copy.
Ian R: Perfect. BetaCorp is breathing easier for now. Please post here when reconciliation complete. :thumbsup:
Dev-Bot: monitor: meter-queue length decreased from 420 -> 12 after manual purge (18:44 UTC)
Billing-Bot: reconciliation started, will post final numbers to BILL-4821 (ETA 4h)
Alex K: Follow-up: reprocessed events reduced free_credits by 2,900 tokens; console now shows remaining_credits = 7,100. I'll keep watching and confirm final invoice alignment.
Ian R: Great work team — please keep me posted and I will update the customer.
